gameMythTroy.title: The Trojan War
gameMythTroy.intro: Lead Achilles, Odysseus and Ajax through ten battles, from the beaches of Troy to the wooden horse. Bonds grow stronger side by side, and rivals burn hotter when they meet.

ending.heading: Ten Years of War
ending.body: The Greek fleet put to sea with Troy burning behind it. Odysseus still has ten years of sailing ahead.

help.heading: How to fight
lines: Tap a unit to see where it can move (blue) and strike (red).
Tap a tile to move there, or tap an enemy to see a forecast. Tap again or press Attack to strike.
Tapping a skill shows what it does first; press Use to cast it. If enemy turns feel long, turn on Fast.
Forests, hills and high ground protect you, and bows shoot farther from above. You cannot climb more than one step at a time.
Heroes joined by a bond (spouses, siblings, friends) fight better side by side. Rivals land far more critical hits on each other.
Fallen heroes withdraw to the ships and return next chapter. Heroes who die in the story are the exception.
